description: K emotion stories for one (emotion, topic) cell. Strict-mode compatible: every field required, additionalProperties false. The story count is not enforced by the schema (no minItems/maxItems); check len(stories) == n_stories in code.

emotion.description: Echo of the requested emotion word.

topic_id.description: Echo of the requested topic id.

text.description: One paragraph of plain prose, about 100-180 words, no line breaks, never naming the emotion or a direct synonym.
